answer.rationale: Incumbent refusal to renegotiate price (despite memory_c4 precedent of successful benchmarking) blocks cost reduction via renewal or negotiation. Switching primary vendor (memory_c2) carries potential delivery risk with only 14 days to contract expiry and 94% line utilization (memory_c1 implies switching involves migration work that could disrupt deliveries). Adding a second source (memory_c3) reduces single-point-of-failure risk while enabling cost reduction through competitive pricing. A small guarded test validates the new vendor's capability and pricing without disrupting current supply, directly supporting the primary objective of minimizing TCO without increasing delivery risk.
